headline: Argentine financial dollar rates climb as rising US yields accelerate capital flight
summary: Parallel exchange rates in Argentina rose and the currency gap widened as higher US Treasury yields and a rising VIX accelerated regional outflows, compounding local activity concerns.
why: Parallel exchange rates in Argentina provide real-time market sentiment on foreign reserve adequacy and capital control sustainability.

impacts.name: Argentine financial dollar
impacts.why: Surging US yields and global volatility prompted portfolio shifts into dollar assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A spike in US yields and global market volatility accelerated regional outflows, pushing parallel FX rates higher.
